newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Bergen County, N.J.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
County of Bergen
New Jersey
General Improvement Bonds
Book Entry Only Bonds, Callable
SEALEDPROPOSALSwill be received by the County Treasurer at
Court Plaza South, 21 Main Street, Hackensack, N.J. on
September 26, 1996
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the above Bonds of the
County dated October 1, 1996 and due (subject to prior
redemption) on October 1 as follows:
$25,000,000 General Improvement Bonds maturing in the
principal amount of $750,000 in each of the years
1997 to 2000, inclusive, $1,000,000 in the year 2001,
and $1,500,000 in each of the years 2002 to 2015,
inclusive.
The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the
form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount
of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable
at the option of the County in accordance with the terms set
forth in the full Notice of Sale. The County will furnish
the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon
&Scotland, Newark, N.J.
The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per
annum in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% (ascending rates and
only one rate per maturity) specified by the successful
bidder payable semiannually on April 1 and October 1 in each
year until maturity, commencing on April 1, 1997. The Bonds
will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan
may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance
with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale.
The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid
forms are available by contacting Alfred Dispoto, the County
Treasurer at Court Plaza South, 21 Main Street, Hackensack,
N.J. 07601, (201) 646-3288. (From The Bond Buyer)
--U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
